verdict.rationale: Lago documents an 'AI agent' platform page claiming users can 'manage billing by describing what you need in plain language,' plus a pre-built Dunning Agent that autonomously reads invoice/payment history and chases overdue accounts, and an Agent SDK for wrapping LLM clients. However, most of this is framed as a developer SDK/framework or a single specialized dunning bot rather than a general-purpose, built-in assistant surfaced in the product UI for delegating arbitrary tasks, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of the plain-language delegation experience. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-product chat/assistant UI usable for arbitrary task delegation, and third-party confirmation that the 'plain language' billing management actually works as described.
